entries.claim: The equation of the straight line with respect to its slope (m) and the y-intercept (b) is y = mx + b, where m ∈ R.
entries.quote: The equation of the straight line with respect to its slope (m)
entries.note: Definition section explicitly states the equation y = mx + b where m ∈ R

entries.claim: Notice that: the equation of the straight line is written ax + by + c = zero, b ≠ 0.
entries.quote: The equation of the straight line is written: ax + by + c = zero, b ≠ 0
entries.note: Notice that section explicitly states the general form ax + by + c = zero with b ≠ 0

entries.claim: From ax + by + c = 0, by = ax - c, so y = -(a/b)x - (c/b), which is in the form y = mx + c; m = -a/b = -(coefficient of x)/(coefficient of y), and c is the length of the y-intercept.
